provenance: Downloaded 2026-09-27 by the Cloud-Opus session directly from the GitHub release page of leanprover/lean4 (no fork, no elan). The GitHub API that would show a publisher digest is not reachable from this session, so the asset hash above is the hash computed on download.
extraction: Selective unzip: bin/lean, bin/leanchecker, lib/lean/*.so, lib/lean/Init.* (Init.olean with its companions .olean.server, .olean.private, .ir, .ir.sig, .ilean), lib/lean/Init/**, lib/glibc/*, lib/libc++*.so, lib/libunwind.so, lib/libgcc_s.so, lib/libatomic.so, lib/libz.so (clang/LLVM and the Lean/Lake/Std libraries are not needed to elaborate an Init-only file). 2026-09-27, later the same day: lib/lean/Lean/**, lib/lean/Lean.*, lib/lean/Std/** and lib/lean/Std.* were extracted from the same local archive into the same prefix (unzip -n: no existing file overwritten; the Init tree hash was re-checked afterwards and is unchanged).
isolation: The driver calls the pinned binaries by absolute path with PATH=<prefix>/bin:/usr/bin:/bin, LEAN_SYSROOT=<prefix>, LEAN_PATH=<temporary build dir>; no elan is installed in this container.
source_policy: enforced by the driver: no sorry, admit, native_decide, axiom declarations, unsafe, implemented_by, extern, opaque or kernel-skipping options
not_pinned: As in the base record, the C/C++ runtime files under lib/ outside lib/lean (glibc, libc++, libunwind, libgcc_s, libatomic, libz) are not pinned; they come from the same archive, whose hash is recorded under release_asset.
